mia (ML Eng): Heads-up — bringing up islay-11b int4 canary on dedicated. baseline perf looks fine but we hit a few OOMs when batch_size > 8 and max_new_tokens is 512. low-frequency but reproducible under a specific prompt mix. sharing quick notes.

sam (Infra): Can you paste the OOM log + the config you used?

mia (ML Eng): Log snippet:```
2024-11-03T14:02:11Z worker-7 OOM: alloc failed for kv_cache (size=1.2G)
stack: runtime.cpp:kv_alloc -> slot_assign -> prefetch_queue -> decode_step
model: islay-11b-int4, quant: q4_0, prefetch=true, max_new_tokens=512, batch_size=12
```

raj (Runtime): Looks like prefetch + large max_new_tokens is growing the KV footprint per request and causing slot fragmentation. int4 reduces model params but KV stays proportional to seq_len * tokens. Prefetch can exacerbate because it pins reservations.

lee (SRE): Are these OOMs on cold-starts or steady-state?

mia (ML Eng): Both, but more frequent on steady-state under mixed short/long prompts. Cold starts sometimes fine, steady-state shows compaction fragmentation over time.

raj (Runtime): Quick hypotheses / mitigations to try: 1) lower default max_new_tokens for islay-11b from 512 -> 256 for canary; 2) disable prefetch for this model temporarily; 3) enable slot compactor on idle (slot_compactor.enabled = true) and reduce slot_reserve from 0.2 -> 0.1; 4) add per-request kv_limit by policy.

sam (Infra): Can you try the config changes as a canary flag? I'd prefer 1 and 3 first. Also add debug metrics: kv_alloc_bytes, slot_free_frag_pct, prefetch_inflight.

mia (ML Eng): Doing canary: updated model route config:```yaml
model: islay-11b-int4
policy: canary-01
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  prefetch: false
  batch_size: 8
runtime_overrides:
  slot_compactor.enabled: true
  slot_compactor.idle_ms: 15000
  slot_reserve: 0.1
```
Triggering canary now.

ci-bot: deploy started -> canary-01 for islay-11b-int4 at 2024-11-03T14:20:05Z :rocket:

mia (ML Eng): Quick smoke: QPS 2 sustained for 10m, no OOMs, avg p95 latency +40ms vs baseline, cost ~+3%. slot_free_frag_pct improved from ~28% -> ~12% after compactor run.

lee (SRE): Nice. Any quality regressions from lowering max_new_tokens?

mia (ML Eng): Ran our mini-eval set (few-shot summaries) — negligible delta on ROUGE/bert_score at 256 vs 512 for our use cases. We'll run full eval overnight.

raj (Runtime): If overnight eval looks clean, plan: roll config to dedicated pool, keep prefetch disabled for 24h, enable slot_compactor globally for that pool. Long term: add adaptive prefetch that respects kv_budget per-request.

sam (Infra): Can we also add an alert rule: if slot_free_frag_pct > 25% for 5m and OOM_count > 0 -> auto-fallback to legacy model variant?

mia (ML Eng): Added alert ticket: INF-3421. Next steps: 1) full eval results (overnight) 2) monitor metrics for 24h 3) if stable, promote settings to prod route and update docs for model defaults.

lee (SRE): Thanks — nice quick triage. :thumbsup:

mia (ML Eng): I'll post eval summary tomorrow. thanks all.
